rows.conditional_reduction: Finite differentiable composition plus reverse chain rule
rows.imported_assumptions: Specified graph, differentiable primitives, loss, parameterization, update rule, optimizer state; nondifferentiable points need a declared convention.
rows.not_established: No unique neural architecture or optimizer follows.

rows.conditional_reduction: Finite Gibbs variational identity in THEORY_V2.md; a binary multiplexer is weaker.
rows.imported_assumptions: Positive reference measure, temperature, energy; bilinear scores, vector features, mask and value readout for dot-product attention.
rows.not_established: Heads, positions, stack depth and empirical superiority remain unspecified.

rows.conditional_reduction: Posterior proportional to prior times likelihood when evidence is positive.
rows.imported_assumptions: Hypothesis domain, prior measure, likelihood and observation event.
rows.not_established: No prior-free interpretation or universal learning advantage.

rows.conditional_reduction: T1 controlled-quotient trace/value theorem and T2 residual bound.
rows.imported_assumptions: Common action set, reward compatibility, normalized action-conditioned kernels, discount, reward bounds and uniform residuals.
rows.not_established: Learning/identifying a sufficient representation is separate.

rows.conditional_reduction: Bellman fixed-point equations for supplied finite discounted MDP.
rows.imported_assumptions: Finite states/actions, known reward/kernel for planning; exploration and stochastic-approximation hypotheses for learning.
rows.not_established: Tabular convergence does not transfer automatically to function approximation.

rows.conditional_reduction: Given normalized reverse kernels, their product and latent marginal define the sampling law.
rows.imported_assumptions: Base law, time index, forward corruption, reverse kernels, schedule, architecture and fitting objective.
rows.not_established: Scalar decrement/refinement does not supply these stochastic semantics.

rows.conditional_reduction: Conditional gated-recurrence reduction in Mamba Theorem1.
rows.imported_assumptions: N=1, A=-1, B=1, linear step selector, softplus step and zero-order-hold discretization.
rows.not_established: The parameterization and useful data distribution are imported.

rows.conditional_reduction: Minimization of a supplied compatibility function.
rows.imported_assumptions: Domain, energy, existence of minimizer and search algorithm; finite partition function for probability interpretation.
rows.not_established: Not every energy defines a probability law; E=0 on R has divergent partition function.

rows.conditional_reduction: Encode a specified formal machine state and its transition.
rows.imported_assumptions: Syntax, inference/transition rules, memory and execution semantics, input/output interface, cost accounting.
rows.not_established: Encoding is not a derivation of language, semantics, soundness or search efficiency.
